system_prompt_style.note: Paper only; no prompt construction described.

env_context_strategy.note: Paper says UserSim builds an inspection context from behaviors and item attributes, but gives no retrieval mechanism.

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no config surface available.

observation_format.note: Inputs include product images, but the paper does not describe the observation format.

tool_count.note: Four typed actions exist in the action space, but no tool list sent to the model is described.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The LLM cannot emit serving code, alter model objectives, target unauthorized scopes, or invoke operations outside𝒜.
edit_primitive.note: The action space is declared in Table 1 and contains no file edits; only bounded parameter updates are possible.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: Candidates that pass both offline stages proceed to strategy-owner review and controlled online A/B testing.
loop_primitives.note: Algorithm 1 is a staged pipeline: UserSim, then Analysis, then Harness, then a four-stage validation. Validation outcomes feed later refinements.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: the Analysis agent runs a structured chain-of-thought that narrows the diagnosis in three stages

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: SR-Agent unifies three components: (i) aUserSimagent that applies inspection skills to surface user-perceived bad cases; (ii) anAnalysisagent

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: The Analysis agent abstracts these cases into diagnoses that describe the underlying failure causes and corresponding refinement directions.
delegation_mechanism.note: Closest value: outputs are handed between stages through the memory banks rather than within one conversation.

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: Candidates that pass both offline stages proceed to strategy-owner review and controlled online A/B testing.
human_in_loop.note: Also 1% sampled audits of bad cases and diagnoses; conflicting updates are escalated to strategy owners.

short_term_state.note: Typed bad-case, diagnosis, and candidate tuples are kept.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: SR-Agent retrieves accumulated experience from three memories to inform subsequent inspection, diagnosis, and strategy refinement.
long_term_memory.note: Bad-Case, Diagnosis (reusable diagnosis skills), and Strategy Memory; Strategy Memory records proposals and their outcomes.

self_verification.evidence_quote: This bad-case retest measures whether the targeted defect is corrected.
self_verification.note: Harness runs the pre-registered strategy scripts on bad cases and replays historical traffic; UserSim acts as an LLM judge.

retry_policy.note: Failed candidates stop; the loop runs continuously, but no retry policy is stated.

rollback.evidence_quote: Failure at any stage stops the candidate, while an online guardrail violation triggers rollback.
rollback.note: Closest value: rollback reverts strategy-state configuration and is not filesystem-based.

cost_controls.note: Reports 36M tokens per loop, but no budget mechanism is described.

permission_model.evidence_quote: A deterministic validator rejects candidates with invalid parameters, unauthorized scopes, unsupported operations, or incompatible strategy versions.
permission_model.note: Also uses whitelisted scopes (static) and human review.

replayability.note: 'Traffic replay' refers to strategy evaluation, not agent trajectory replay.

guardrails.evidence_quote: Its action space, output schema, scope permissions, and deployment guardrails are fixed and cannot be modified by the LLM.

target_domain.evidence_quote: the first agentic framework deployed to refine post-ranking strategies in industrial RS
target_domain.note: The domain is e-commerce recommender strategy refinement.

model_agnostic.note: Only Claude Sonnet 4.6 is used; no abstraction is described.
